Its Windows full-matrix duration exceeded the unchanged 15000 ms deadline. The recorded failure is a timeout, not a failed build-evidence rejection assertion.
failure.whyPreviousRepairWasInsufficient: Matrix1 optimized the artifact-only mutation case but left repeated whole-preflight work in the separate failed-rebuild and reusable-build cases. This failed-rebuild case had already taken close to the timeout while passing matrix1; targeted success did not establish its full-matrix timing margin.
failure.diagnosticLimits: No CPU/I/O profiling established the precise host-load contribution; a Linux pass and narrow Windows pass do not invalidate the observed full Windows timeout.
